fullTextZH: 可能是因为你自己不喜欢你自己。
fullTextEN: it might be because you don't like yourself.

fullTextZH: 所以现在我觉得我更接受我自己，
fullTextEN: So now I feel I accept myself more,

fullTextZH: 那我觉得可能我对男人也更开放，就是，
fullTextEN: I think maybe I'm more open to men, that is,
Ah, whether he's tall or short,

fullTextZH: 可能现在他的工作不稳定，
fullTextEN: Maybe now his job is unstable,

fullTextZH: 或者说他的身材没有很好，
fullTextEN: Or his body shape isn't very good,

fullTextZH: 我觉得现在可能我也觉得没问题。嗯。
fullTextEN: I think now maybe I also think it's no problem. Hmm.

fullTextZH: 嗯，以前跟你约会的男人，
fullTextEN: Hmm, the men you used to date,

fullTextZH: 不可以，因为已经有男朋友了。
fullTextEN: No, they can't, because I already have a boyfriend.
